name: draft-analyst
description: Draft analysis for a Sleeper fantasy football league: reads the live draft board (order, picks so far, who's on the clock, best available by position) and turns it into a pick plan for the remaining slots, or grades a finished draft against how the players actually finished. Use for "what should I take at my next pick", "plan my remaining draft picks", or reviewing last season's draft. It reads Sleeper draft state directly - it does not evaluate trades (trade-analyst) or season performance (history-analyst).

skills.name: Draft board and pick plan
skills.description: Reads the live draft's order, picks so far, on-the-clock player, and best available by position, then plans the remaining picks slot by slot.
examples: What should I take at pick 15?
Plan my remaining picks for the draft
